subject.title: fix(xai): bound stalled generated video download body reads

question: Should xAI generated-video downloads gain a distinct, shorter body-idle policy, or should they retain only the existing overall request deadline and its generic timeout error?
rationale: The current single timeout value cannot simultaneously act as an earlier request wall clock and a later-starting idle timer while guaranteeing the new error; selecting a shorter idle window changes valid slow-transfer behavior and needs owner intent.

options.title: Define distinct idle budget
options.body: Choose and test a provider-owned idle duration shorter than the request deadline so genuine mid-body stalls receive the xAI-specific error.

options.title: Keep wall-clock only
options.body: Remove the redundant chunk timer and retain the existing guarded request deadline until a justified idle policy is available.

recommendation.title: Define distinct idle budget
recommendation.body: Choose and test a provider-owned idle duration shorter than the request deadline so genuine mid-body stalls receive the xAI-specific error.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged xAI media timeout work is the closest available history signal for deciding how provider operation and download-idle budgets should relate.
